(Japanese: 黒の巻：ノブナガの野望 The Black Scroll: Nobunaga's Ambition) is the sixth and final chapter of the Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~ manga

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
While preparing for a festival, the Warlords get into a fight in what color to paint their carriage, only for it to be destroyed by a bolt of lightning.
After seeing a flying Zekrom, the heroine gets the idea to make paper lanterns for the festival.
Later, Oichi and the heroine encounter Nobunaga and his Zekrom flying through the skies and asks him to join them for the festival.
Nobunaga accepts, and all the Warlords celebrate at the festival.
